name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Slides a heading or paragraph up from behind a mask, one line, word or letter at a time.
behaviour: SplitText breaks the text into lines, words or letters and wraps each in a clipping mask, then each unit rises from just below its mask into place, offset from the one before by the stagger. When splitting by lines the text is re-split whenever fonts finish loading or the box changes width, so a line never breaks in the wrong place on a phone. Inline markup such as <em> survives the split, and screen readers hear the original sentence rather than the fragments. The split is undone when the component unmounts or a prop changes, leaving your markup exactly as authored. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce nothing is split and the whole block fades in over 0.2s.
demoChildren: Roasted in Yaba on Tuesday, in your cup by Thursday.
